retained_artifact.qualification: Reviewed documented-source-screen scope; dry is supported; flower and nectar modes are supported; all A missions retain their original purpose; packet values fit implementation bounds. Preflight checks cover required task fields, source presence and required-host enum omitted or broader in general compiler validation. Empty-string lot IDs do not occur in this packet.

boundary_cases: distinct taxa instead of row count
aggregate overdemand blocks both comparable rows
zero week and zero price accepted
unknown taxon and missing/unknown lots remain findings

retries_corrections.detail: The initial combined file output was truncated. Packet and catalog were reread compactly before execution.

limitations: Finite supplied source-screen contract only; no oracle or protected answers inspected.
Source/catalog facts held fixed; no botanical inference, current inventory authentication or external verification.

Retained compiler has broader-contract validation limits outside this packet, including missing quoted price defaulting to zero, unrestricted nonempty host strings, absent source checks, bounded numeric/list limits, and empty lot identifiers not normalized in emitted blockers.
